title: Rank-aware local algorithm and stopping-policy comparison
objective: Select a fixed-start local root-solving policy that increases canonical Gold-root capture on rank-deficient, tangent and warped systems without accepting low-residual nonroots or making the open plugin ABI solver-specific.
hypothesis: A scaled trust-region dogleg route with a stricter canonical residual gate will improve difficult-root capture and oracle cost over the in-house LM-QR control, while a large robustness polyalgorithm will not justify its cold and fallback cost on regular families.

included: bounded C0/C1 smooth square and overdetermined systems
fixed saved starts and identical residual/variable scaling
in-house LM-QR, NonlinearSolve LM, trust-region and robustness polyalgorithm controls
canonical endpoint replay and independent Gold configuration/target checks
cold compilation, warm wall time and primal-equivalent oracle work
excluded: hard target-based suppression or residual deflation
singular-root certification and exact target recognition
C0-only nonsmooth promotion based only on a package return code
adding NonlinearSolve as a production dependency before the locked gate passes

literature.claim: NonlinearSolve compares unified Newton, least-squares, trust-region and quasi-Newton implementations in Julia.
literature.assumptions: The problem satisfies the selected algorithm interface and derivative route.
literature.break_conditions: A successful optimizer return is not proof of a canonical root, guard or branch.

literature.claim: The official solver guide exposes Levenberg-Marquardt, Gauss-Newton and trust-region algorithms for nonlinear least squares.
literature.assumptions: Residual minimization is a useful smooth local model.
literature.break_conditions: Positive-residual stationary points, invalid domains and unstable branch charts remain possible.

literature.claim: Broyden iteration has local linear convergence for a stated class of roots with singular Jacobian.
literature.assumptions: The root and initial point satisfy the paper's special-region and singularity hypotheses.
literature.break_conditions: The guarantee is not global and does not establish discovery of every root.

literature.claim: Approximate left and right Jacobian nullspaces can form a bordered system with quadratic convergence near generalized regular singularities.
literature.assumptions: Reliable rank and nullspace estimates exist near an isolated singular root.
literature.break_conditions: Opaque derivatives, manifolds, noisy rank thresholds or nonisolated roots invalidate the route.

literature.claim: Rank-deficient nonlinear least-squares accuracy can be damaged by ill-defined numerical rank and unstable truncated singular-vector selection.
literature.assumptions: Residual and Jacobian errors are material near a rank transition.
literature.break_conditions: A fixed SVD cutoff is not a universally safe repair.

controls.description: Current bounds-scaled variables and declared residual scales with finite-difference LM and column-pivoted QR.
Trust-region execution with the generator's analytic Jacobian where available, used only to separate derivative error from step policy.

candidates.description: NonlinearSolve Levenberg-Marquardt with the frozen scaling, finite-difference route and canonical endpoint gate.
NonlinearSolve trust-region dogleg with the frozen scaling and canonical endpoint gate.
NonlinearSolve RobustMultiNewton fallback sequence with all fallback work charged.
Trust-region route with the preregistered stricter internal residual threshold and unchanged independent validation.

synthetic_families.purpose: Exercise scaling, curvature, rank loss, strict guards, tangency, opaque callbacks, multiple roots and redundancy under one truth policy.
synthetic_families.gold_source: GeoTargetBenchmarks analytic configurations and independently materialized target truth

synthetic_families.purpose: Resolve whether the trust-region pilot gain survives seed, dimension and conditioning changes.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Constructed SVD roots and closed-form circle-line intersections

synthetic_families.purpose: Detect policies that converge reliably but collapse onto only the easiest target basins.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Invertible analytic warp of known configurations and targets
counterexample_for: aggregate residual success without all-target recall

real_problem_policy: Only independently audited Gold problems may affect selection; translated cases measure timing until separately audited.

execution_order: Verify exact package/environment versions and run semantic adapter tests
Run a small non-gating pilot to reject broken adapters
Execute paired development instances at every fixed-start prefix
Freeze one route and one stopping threshold after at most one tuning round
Run family-disjoint locked validation and charge cold compilation
design.pairing: All variants receive identical generated problems, saved starts, scale vectors, endpoint truth predicates and launch prefixes.
design.freeze_rule: Algorithm, derivative backend, stop threshold and fallback order freeze before locked validation.
design.locked_validation_rule: Inspecting a locked failure burns the family seed block and requires a generator-disjoint replacement.
notes: Package retcodes are diagnostic only; canonical and Gold gates decide success.
The C0 opaque family can reject an incompatible derivative route but cannot by itself justify high-assurance promotion.
A stricter residual threshold is judged by target correctness and cost, never by residual counts alone.

local_maxiters.rationale: Matches the permanent local control and bounds per-start work.

internal_residual_threshold.rationale: The pilot exposed target-inaccurate endpoints under sqrt-eps on ill-conditioned systems.
internal_residual_threshold.freeze_rule: Choose once using development false-candidate and work curves.

derivative_route.rationale: Available for the full black-box C0 development envelope.
derivative_route.freeze_rule: Capability routing is explicit and frozen before locked execution.

fixed_starts_per_instance.rationale: Provides paired basin comparisons while keeping cold experiments tractable.
fixed_starts_per_instance.freeze_rule: Persist and checksum starts before executing variants.

gold_configuration_tolerance.rationale: Makes configuration truth matching explicit in normalized variable coordinates.
gold_configuration_tolerance.freeze_rule: Fixed before the pilot and never widened from observed misses.

pilot_target_tolerance.rationale: Separates exploratory target matching from exact or validated answer claims.
pilot_target_tolerance.freeze_rule: Pilot-only fixed tolerance; locked truth uses the benchmark metric contract.

budgets.accounting: Charge package load, compilation, derivative work, every residual/Jacobian call, factorization, fallback and canonical validation.

seeds.generation: Family parameters and saved starts use separate fixed seed namespaces and materialized checksums.

primary.definition: Fraction of fixed starts ending at a canonical valid independently matched Gold configuration and target.

secondary.definition: Fraction of instances whose prefix recovers every distinct Gold target.
Primal-equivalent oracle work through a Gold-valid endpoint.
Cold first-use and warm paired local wall time reported separately.
Canonical residual-qualified endpoints outside Gold target/configuration tolerance.

safety.definition: Endpoints accepted despite failing canonical or independent Gold truth.
Attempts exceeding declared iteration, evaluation or wall budgets.
Silent derivative or numeric capability fallback events.

criteria: False-candidate, budget-overrun and silent-capability-fallback counts are zero.
P_local_gold improves by at least 5 percentage points or oracle work drops by at least 20 percent at equal recall.
Near-rank and tangent strata each improve by at least 10 points or 20 percent work without a multiroot recall loss.
No unrelated regular family loses more than 2 P_local_gold points or gains more than 10 percent warm overhead.
The paired family-clustered 95 percent interval is on the improvement side in at least three unrelated families.
Cold package and compilation cost breaks even within 32 starts for problems selecting the external route.
Any package retcode bypasses canonical or Gold validation.
A candidate accepts more target-inaccurate low-residual endpoints than the control.
All-target recall drops by more than 2 points in close-root or tangent strata.
A robustness polyalgorithm remains within 5 percent of the simpler trust-region route after fallback work is charged.
Cold cost fails to break even within 128 starts and no critical recall gain remains.
The improvement fails to reproduce after the single declared tuning round.

safety_invariants: No local solver return code is an answer predicate.
Every endpoint is replayed through canonical relation, domain, guard, branch and target semantics.
The fixed independent start stream is identical across variants.
Routing uses capabilities and measured numerical diagnostics, never family or problem identity.
A production dependency is added only after the locked end-to-end gate passes.

decision.rationale: The preregistered ROUTE-LMTR-A1 development round preserved truth and slightly improved recall, but its fully charged warm wall was 3.03 times the simple NLS-TR control. The warm-wall gate failed, locked inputs were never materialized, and no production dependency or route is authorized.
